structure.summary: Unverified. The Delaware Republican Party's bylaws organize the party into five regions built from representative districts and leave local selection to region rules, which are not published. State law sets no committee-person election.
structure.seat_data_source: No official seat-level source; would require party rosters.

notes: Totals cover the counties listed in `counties` that have a seat list. Counties without one, or with only a partial list (coverage: partial), are not in the totals. Seat status follows war_map/committee/README.md.

counties.name: Kent County
counties.coverage_note: Eight representative district chair positions are listed. Election district committeeperson seats and other party offices have not been enumerated, so this is not a complete county seat count.

counties.name: New Castle County
counties.coverage_note: This lists seven representative district chair positions in the Colonial Region only. Northern and Western New Castle regions, election district committeepersons, and other offices have not been enumerated.

counties.name: Sussex County
counties.coverage_note: Ten representative district chair positions are listed. The party says each election district has two committeepersons, but their seat status has not been documented here, so this is not a complete county seat count.
